Factsdailyy on Instagram: "I refuse to believe we lost Chuck Norris 💔🕊️

Chuck Norris was an American martial artist and actor who became a major action star. He gained fame through martial arts championships and films, later starring in Walker, Texas Ranger. Known for his toughness and discipline, he passed at 86, leaving behind a lasting legacy and a powerful cultural impact.
